description: Today's trending Google searches for one country (public Google Trends RSS): rank, query, approximate search volume (e.g. '200+'), and the news items behind each trend. Country only: Google's feed has no industry categories, and it lists daily trends, not a breakout history. Usually takes about 10 s, up to 23 s on slower calls; allow a 45 s timeout. Related tools on this server, for a different need: agent_intel_bytecode_similarity_radar when you need to compare the runtime bytecode of two Ethereum contracts you; agent_intel_news_radar when you need latest BBC News headlines from one section feed. Price: $0.002 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

geo.description: Two-letter country code, e.g. US, GB, DE, TR, FR (default US)
